extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: airship / zeppelin-style blimp, approx. 44.9 x 16.8 x 17.2 m (L x fin span x H), envelope diameter 10.4 m, gondola 6.6 m
extras.notes: nose faces -Y; ground contact: the airship rests on two gondola wheels and a tail wheel under the lower fin (wheel bottoms at z = 0; in flight simply hide or ignore them); 2 propellers (origin on the hub, spin around the engine axis) and 3 wheels (origin on the axle, roll around local X) are separate objects; envelope made of 16 gently pillowed gores; opaque tinted windows, no interior; no brand, no text, no registration

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
